title: Twisted representations of product systems of $C^*$-correspondences: Wold decomposition and unitary extensions
summary: We investigate Wold-type decompositions and unitary extension problems for multivariable isometric covariant representations associated with product systems of $C^*$-correspondences. First, we establish an operator-theoretic characterization for the existence of a Wold decomposition for the tuple $(σ, T_1, T_2, \ldots, T_n)$, where each $(σ,T_i)$ is an isometric covariant representation of a $C^*$\nobreakdash-correspondence.
